description: This file defines two Orleans grain classes, VersionUpgradeTestGrain and VersionPlacementTestGrain, which implement versioning and placement strategies respectively. It includes methods for retrieving version info, proxying calls, and lifecycle hooks with logging.

classes.name: VersionUpgradeTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing version upgrade logic with logging and lifecycle management.

classes.name: VersionPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing version-aware placement strategy with logging.

methods.name: GetVersion
methods.description: Returns the current version number of the grain.

methods.name: ProxyGetVersion
methods.description: Proxies a call to another grain to get its version.

methods.name: LongRunningTask
methods.description: Performs a long-running task with a delay.
